grain.fct_enrollment_span: one row per member (their single enrolment span)
grain.fct_claim_line: one row per adjudicated claim LINE
grain.vw_member_month: one row per member per enrolled month - the conformed grain every ratio metric is defined against
grain.vw_provider_coding: one row per provider per month, professional claims only

member_month_fanout_check.why: if these diverge a join has fanned out and every ratio metric has gained denominator rows that do not exist

note: the month spine keeps zero-claim member-months in the denominator; dropping them turns PMPM into 'average cost among members who claimed', which is a different and much larger number
